title: Every current in η(U) is a blow-up of a current in U, preserving integer multiplicity
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, x ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and η = η_{x,λ}. For every S' ∈ 𝒟_n(η(U)) there is S'' ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with η_{x,λ#}S'' = S', and S'' is integer multiplicity whenever S' is.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (S' : GeometricCurrentOn (dilation x lam '' U) n), ∃ S'' : GeometricCurrentOn U n, blowUp S'' x lam hlam.ne' = S' ∧ (IsIntegerMultiplicity S' → IsIntegerMultiplicity S'')
